paragraphs: Recollect sells a cloud-based Collection Management System for galleries, libraries, archives, museums, academic institutions and heritage sites. The product is presented as management and discovery for a digital collection, held in a single digital repository built to support staff, students, and researchers. Metadata and contextual information configure the site and link assets together, and content of any format is reached from any device.

The about page lists the organisations the platform supports, beginning with libraries, archives and museums wanting to digitise and share their collections. That list also names local government bodies preserving public records. It further names indigenous and marginalised communities seeking tools for managing culturally sensitive materials, and educational institutions providing students and researchers with accessible resources.

The same page states that by 2020 the company became a standalone entity, expanding into the USA, UK, Australia, Singapore and Hong Kong. It reports support for over 160 sites globally. Case studies name the Museum of Flight, Palos Verdes Library District, the State Library of Oregon and Denver Public Library.

quote.text: With Recollect's cloud-based platform, build your identity, enrich your collections, capture and manage new content, as well as discuss new ideas from anywhere in the world
